
# NGS DATA PROCESSING

```bash
    BaseDir="/data/scRNAseq/02.Public-Datasets"
    BatchID="002.Tabula-Muris-Senis-SmartSeq2"
    SeqPlatform="BulkRNAseq" # BulkRNAseq scRNAseq SmartSeq2   
```

- processing.config
    - `Seqplatform` : sequencing platform. enable values : BulkRNAseq, scRNAseq, SmartSeq2
    - `SeqID` : sample-id
    - `ReferenceType` : mm39_ercc_plus (SmartSeq2), mm39(scRNAseq, BulkRNAseq)

## meta info 



```r
    META_DIR="/data/scRNAseq/02.Public-Datasets/002.Tabula-Muris-Senis/meta"

    sinfo_list = readRDS("/data/scRNAseq/02.Public-Datasets/002.Tabula-Muris-Senis/meta/GCX.Pipeline.Setup.Dataset.Info.RDS" )

    sinfo_bulk <- sinfo_list[["BulkRNAseq"]]
    sinfo_bulk_out <- data.frame(
        BaseDir=BaseDir,
        BatchID=BatchID,
        SeqPlatform="BulkRNAseq",
        SeqID=sinfo_bulk$GCX_ID,
        GenomeAssembly="mm39",
        IndivID=sinfo_bulk$Mouse_ID
    )
    write.table(sinfo_bulk_out, sprintf("%s/processing.BulkRNAseq.list", META_DIR ), quote=F, col.names=T, row.names=F, sep=" ")

    sinfo_scrnaseq <- sinfo_list[[ "scRNAseq" ]]
    sinfo_scrnaseq_out <- data.frame(
        BaseDir=BaseDir,
        BatchID=BatchID,
        SeqPlatform = "scRNAseq",
        SeqBatchID       = sinfo_scrnaseq$fastq_batch,
        GenomeAssembly   = "mm39",
        IndivID = sinfo_scrnaseq$mouse.id
    )
    write.table(sinfo_scrnaseq, sprintf("%s/processing.scRNAseq.list", META_DIR ), quote=F, col.names=F, row.names=F, sep=" ")

    sinfo_smartseq2 <- sinfo_list[[ "SmartSeq2" ]]
    sinfo_smartseq2 <- data.frame(
        SeqPlatform = "SmartSeq2",
        SeqID       = sinfo_smartseq2$GCX_ID,
        Reference   = "mm39_ercc.plus"
    )
    write.table(sinfo_smartseq2, sprintf("%s/processing.SmartSeq2.list", META_DIR ), quote=F, col.names=F, row.names=F, sep=" ")
```

## FASTQ QC

```bash    

    BaseDir="/data/scRNAseq/02.Public-Datasets"
    BatchID="002.Tabula-Muris-Senis-SmartSeq2"
    SeqPlatform="BulkRNAseq" # BulkRNAseq scRNAseq SmartSeq2   
    SeqPlatform="scRNAseq" # BulkRNAseq scRNAseq SmartSeq2   
    SeqPlatform="SmartSeq2" # BulkRNAseq scRNAseq SmartSeq2   

    ProcessingListFile=${BaseDir}/${BatchID}/meta/processing.${SeqPlatform}.list

    RunInfo=$(sed -n -e "${SGE_TASK_ID} p" ${ProcessingListFile})
    SeqPlatform=$(echo ${RunInfo} | awk '{print $1}')
    SeqID=$(echo ${RunInfo} | awk '{print $2}')
    GenomeAssembly=$(echo ${RunInfo} | awk '{print $3}')


    RunFastqc="singularity exec -B/storage,/data /storage/images/fastqc-0.12.1.sif fastqc"
    RunFastp="singularity exec -B/storage,/data /storage/images/fastp-0.24.0.sif fastp"

    RawFastqDir="${BaseDir}/${BatchID}/fastq/${SeqPlatform}"
    QcDir="${BaseDir}/${BatchID}/${SeqPlatform}/${SeqID}/qcfiles"
    mkdir -p ${QcDir}
    export LC_ALL=C
    export LANG=C
    if [[ ! -f "${QcDir}/FASTQC.Done" ]]; then
        ${RunFastqc} --extract --threads 2 --outdir ${QcDir} ${RawFastqDir}/${SeqID}_R1.fastq.gz ${RawFastqDir}/${SeqID}_R2.fastq.gz
        touch "${QcDir}/FASTQC.Done"
    fi

    TrimFastqDir="${BaseDir}/${BatchID}/${SeqPlatform}/${SeqID}/fastq"
    mkdir -p "${TrimFastqDir}"
    if [[ ! -f "${QcDir}/${SeqID}.fastp.json" ]]; then 
        FASTP_ARGS=("--trim_poly_g")
        FASTP_ARGS+=("--length_required 20")
        FASTP_ARGS+=("--thread 6")
        FASTP_ARGS+=("--in1 ${RawFastqDir}/${SeqID}_R1.fastq.gz")
        FASTP_ARGS+=("--in2 ${RawFastqDir}/${SeqID}_R2.fastq.gz")
        FASTP_ARGS+=("--out1 ${TrimFastqDir}/${SeqID}.trimmed_R1.fastq.gz")
        FASTP_ARGS+=("--out2 ${TrimFastqDir}/${SeqID}.trimmed_R2.fastq.gz")
        FASTP_ARGS+=("--json ${QcDir}/${SeqID}.fastp.json")
        FASTP_ARGS+=("--html ${QcDir}/${SeqID}.fastp.html")

        ${RunFastp} ${FASTP_ARGS[@]}
    fi
```

## Bulk
```bash 
    RunStar="singularity exec -B /storage,/data /storage/images/star-2.7.11.sif  STAR"
    RunStrandCheck="python3 /storage/apps/RSeQC-5.0.1/scripts/infer_experiment.py"
    
    ResourceDir="/storage/references_and_index/scRNAseq"
    StarIndex="${ResourceDir}/${GenomeAssembly}/star"
    GtfGile="${ResourceDir}/${GenomeAssembly}/genes/genes.gtf"
    Threads=16

    TrimFastqDir="${BaseDir}/${BatchID}/${SeqPlatform}/${SeqID}/fastq"
    BamDir="${BaseDir}/${BatchID}/${SeqPlatform}/${SeqID}/bam"
    mkdir -p ${BamDir}

    if [[ "${SeqPlatform}" = "BulkRNAseq" ]]; then
        STAR_ARGS=("--genomeDir ${StarIndex}")
        STAR_ARGS+=("--sjdbGTFfile ${GtfGile}")
        STAR_ARGS+=("--runThreadN ${Threads}")
        STAR_ARGS+=("--readFilesIn ${TrimFastqDir}/${SeqID}.trimmed_R1.fastq.gz ${TrimFastqDir}/${SeqID}.trimmed_R2.fastq.gz")
        STAR_ARGS+=("--readFilesCommand zcat")
        STAR_ARGS+=("--quantMode TranscriptomeSAM")
        STAR_ARGS+=("--genomeLoad NoSharedMemory")
        STAR_ARGS+=("--twopassMode Basic")
        STAR_ARGS+=("--outSAMtype BAM SortedByCoordinate")
        STAR_ARGS+=("--outFileNamePrefix ${BamDir}/${SeqID}.")

        ${RunStar} ${STAR_ARGS[@]}


        ${RunStrandCheck} -i "${BamDir}/${SeqID}.Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.bam" -r "${GeneModelBed}" > ${QcDir}/infer_strand_result.txt
        Rscript /storage/apps/RSeQC-5.0.1/scripts/infer_result_to_config.R ${QcDir}/infer_strand_result.txt
        strand_info=$(cat ${QcDir}/stranded_config.txt)      
        FeatureCountStrandParam=$(echo ${strand_info} | awk '{print $1}')
        SalmonLibraryType=$(echo ${strand_info} | awk '{print $2}')
    fi

```

## scRNAseq (Droplet)

```bash
    RunStar="singularity exec -B /storage,/data /storage/images/star-2.7.11.sif  STAR"
    ResourceDir="/storage/references_and_index/scRNAseq"
    StarIndex="${ResourceDir}/${GenomeAssembly}/star"
    GtfGile="${ResourceDir}/${GenomeAssembly}/genes/genes.gtf"
    Threads=8

    TrimFastqDir="${BaseDir}/${BatchID}/${SeqPlatform}/${SeqID}/fastq"
    BamDir="${BaseDir}/${BatchID}/${SeqPlatform}/${SeqID}/bam"
    mkdir -p ${BamDir}

    if [[ "${SeqPlatform}" = "scRNAseq" ]]; then
        STAR_ARGS=("--genomeDir ${StarIndex}")
        STAR_ARGS+=("--sjdbGTFfile ${GtfGile}")
        STAR_ARGS+=("--runThreadN ${Threads}")
        STAR_ARGS+=("--readFilesIn ${TrimFastqDir}/${SeqID}.trimmed_R1.fastq.gz ${TrimFastqDir}/${SeqID}.trimmed_R2.fastq.gz")
        STAR_ARGS+=("--readFilesCommand zcat")
        STAR_ARGS+=("--quantMode TranscriptomeSAM")
        STAR_ARGS+=("--genomeLoad NoSharedMemory")
        STAR_ARGS+=("--outSAMtype BAM SortedByCoordinate")
        STAR_ARGS+=("--outFileNamePrefix ${BamDir}/${SeqID}.")

        ${RunStar} ${STAR_ARGS[@]}

        FeatureCountStrandParam="0"
        SalmonLibraryType="IU"
    fi




```
